cards.card_text: The calf's people and its idolatrous priests will mourn over the calf of Beth-aven.
cards.verse_text: Indeed, its people will mourn over it with its idolatrous priests—those who rejoiced in its glory—for it has been taken from them into exile.
cards.snippet: Indeed, its people will mourn over it with its idolatrous priests—those who rejoiced in its glory—for it has been taken from them…

cards.card_text: Along with every remnant of Baal, a false god, the LORD says He will cut off from this place the names of the idolatrous and pagan ___.
cards.verse_text: I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—
